SRC-298:R001.text: A ZAICODE session has a supported, verifiable way to deliver a genuine operator cc that renews a bounded run: a host adapter exists, is installed, and is dispatched on the operator's prompt event.

SRC-298:R002.text: An agent CLI replay, a shell call or another session's envelope cannot renew the bounded grant: an unsealed or wrong-session carrier retains hard_wait.

SRC-298:R003.text: When the native bridge is absent, the refusal names the infrastructure owner and the accurate recovery prerequisite, and never reports an advisory skill or a repeated cc as authenticated recovery.
